title: KiCad in the Browser
claim: Show HN: KiCad in the Browser
why_good: KiCad (pro PCB design) running in the browser — removes install friction for a serious, growing hardware/maker audience.
value: Freemium browser EDA + a cloud/collab/manufacturing tier; hardware teams pay for collaboration and fab integration.
risk: KiCad is free and desktop-entrenched; browser EDA (EasyEDA, Flux) exists — needs collab/fab hooks to matter.

zh.claim: Show HN: 浏览器里的 KiCad。
zh.why_good: 把 KiCad(专业 PCB 设计)搬进浏览器——为认真、增长中的硬件/创客群体去掉安装摩擦。
zh.value: 浏览器 EDA 免费增值 + 云/协作/制造档;硬件团队为协作和打样集成付费。
zh.risk: KiCad 免费且桌面根基深;浏览器 EDA(EasyEDA、Flux)已在——要靠协作/打样接口才有意义。
